tailoring.headline: Full Stack Lead | SAP Commerce (Hybris) Expert | Java, Spring, REST APIs
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with over 5 years delivering enterprise e-commerce solutions on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105/2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring, Spring Boot, RESTful and OCC APIs, and headless commerce. Proven track record designing and integrating PIM-ERP-MDM data pipelines, optimizing database performance, and leading full-stack implementations that span backend services, API layers, and PWA front-ends. Skilled in agile, CI/CD, Docker/Kubernetes, and techno-functional analysis with international stakeholders.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Full Stack Lead
cover_en.hook: I am excited about Alexia Bovy’s ambition to lead a cutting-edge full-stack team delivering SAP solutions in Belgium. With more than five years of hands-on experience building and scaling SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) platforms for Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep expertise in Java, Spring and end-to-end e-commerce integrations that align perfectly with your needs.

bullets.label: Full-Stack Architecture
bullets.text: Designed and delivered end-to-end SAP Commerce Cloud solutions covering backend services, OCC REST APIs and PWA front-ends, ensuring seamless full-stack performance for global B2B/B2C portals.

bullets.label: Hybris Integration
bullets.text: Built robust PIM-ERP-MDM data pipelines using Profisee, DataHub and Hotfolders, and migrated complex customer account APIs, guaranteeing data consistency across SAP environments.

bullets.label: API Development
bullets.text: Created and exposed high-volume OCC and custom REST web services, optimized for scalability and integrated with third-party systems, supporting headless commerce initiatives.

bullets.label: Leadership & Agile
bullets.text: Led code reviews, mentored junior developers, and collaborated with international stakeholders to translate business requirements into functional specifications within Scrum teams.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe, I hold a valid German work permit, am serving notice until 15 December 2026 and can start on 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how I can contribute to your team.

tailoring.why_company: Alexia Bovy’s focus on delivering innovative SAP solutions and its strategic presence in Belgium align with my passion for driving digital commerce transformation. The opportunity to lead a full-stack team that leverages SAP Commerce (Hybris) while integrating BI and SCM components excites me, as I can apply my proven expertise in Java, Spring and end-to-end e-commerce integrations to help the company expand its market impact and deliver superior customer experiences.
tailoring.motivation_short: I want to lead Alexia Bovy’s full-stack SAP commerce initiatives, applying my 5+ years of Hybris expertise to drive innovative, high-performance e-commerce solutions in Belgium.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti Chavan, a senior SAP Commerce (Hybris) developer with 5+ years at Rockwell Automation and Shell. I’m eager to lead your Full Stack team in Belgium. Could we discuss how my experience fits Alexia Bovy’s vision?
tailoring.email_subject: Application for Full Stack Lead – Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Full Stack Lead position at Alexia Bovy. With over five years of SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I have a proven record in full-stack development, API integration and leading agile teams. I am based in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit, and can start on 16 December 2026. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss my fit.
